question: Top 5 de grupos empresarios por monto en contratos del sector NAICS 5415 (servicios informáticos) y sus subsectores, sumando todas las empresas de cada grupo.

attempts.query:
SELECT grupo FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(r.parent_name, ''), r.name) AS grupo, SUM(c.amount) AS total
  FROM usaspending.contract c
  JOIN usaspending.recipient r ON r.recipient_id = c.recipient_id
  WHERE c.naics_code LIKE '5415%'
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY total DESC
  LIMIT 5
) t
